improvements.action: Fix the zone score fallback pipeline immediately — verify it actually scans all 50 Nifty stocks when AI is unavailable. improvements.reason: The fallback's conservatism produced zero setups on a day where broad market participation was extremely high. Relaxing thresholds in confirmed uptrends captures trending-day alpha without adding much risk.
